propositions: After Jira returns a create key, the known key must be persisted on the still-pending RP-02 entry via record_pending_key + save BEFORE attempting to attach the canonical rebar-id label, establishing a write-ahead protocol that enables deterministic recovery via the keyed-pending branch if a crash occurs during the create-to-label window.

The canonical rebar-id:<local_id> label must be attached before optional entity property enrichment is attempted, and property failure (unsupported or permission denied) must remain visible as an enrichment failure without removing the successful label.

Any post-create failure (during label, property, or confirmation) must preserve the known key, local recovery evidence, and the remote Jira issue without deletion; bind_confirm must execute last after all label and property operations.

The binding lifecycle must use only the RP-02 BindingStore facade for persistence, recording the known key and confirmation, and never create a second binding writer or bypass the canonical identity floor.
